_about: Optional outcome prior for kit/scripts/find_textures.py, filled later by a lab script. Format: {texture id: {"n": number of effect runs that used it, "score": mean 0..10 human or panel score of those effects, "roles": {role: {"n": runs, "score": mean}}}}. The search shrinks it towards a neutral 5 (Bayesian average, 3 neutral runs), so a texture needs several runs before it moves much. Missing ids or an empty file = no effect.
